text: We have estabilished a satisfactory trade network with our neighbours. What matters now is how we continue handling our trade markets.

One of the local pasta recipes is a traditional staple. However, it is just as traditional for people, from the family mother to the renowned cook, to squabble over one particular ingredient being used, replaced or not. The issue has come up again and there have been fights from street to mansion level. What would you tell people to settle this down, at least for the moment?

One of the artists under your patronage found a handful of sketches that look distinctly Leonardo da Miragliano-esque. If anything, they are written in a thick spidery and mirrored script, every page full to the edge of further notes and sketches. An emissary from Altdorf has heard of the rumours and seems eager to get the notes to his Emperor.

We have reports of a hedge wizard operating in the area. He seems to be keeping to himself, and yet is known to help the local populace in everyday issues. He could be a useful asset for our troops, but the northeners often execute these untrained mages on sight for fear of them turning into some horror or the other. What would you choose?

Centuries ago, the Order of Nahmud retrieved scrolls that could have been important texts concerning the Dark Maiden or her friend, Holy Myrmidia herself. Allegedly, any attempt to translate the texts was in vain until an elven guest managed the deed and suffered a deadly and unlikely accident for it. The issue has resurfaced and rumours are already circulating about the alleged secrets of the scrolls. Reports mention whispers musing the concept that Holy Myrmidia was actually an Elf, or even worse, an Arabyan! \\n\\n What would you have us do about the matter?
